results.name: Band Spanish Split Squat
instructions: Stand in a split stance with your left leg forward and the other leg behind you, facing sturdy equipment. Loop a resistance band around your left leg, just under the knee, and anchor it in front of you at knee level.
Hold your hands together in front of your chest and keep your torso upright.
Lower your body straight down by bending both knees until your left thigh is parallel to the floor.
Push through the heel of your left foot to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired repetitions, switch legs, and repeat.
tips: Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning forward during the movement.
Drive through the heel of your front foot for better glute and quad engagement.
Adjust the band tension before starting to ensure proper resistance.
Inhale as you lower and exhale as you stand.
results.description: Band Spanish Split Squat is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves, Abdominals.

results.name: Band Standing Leg Curl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding to a weight cage for balance. Attach a resistance band to a low anchor point and loop the other end around your right ankle. Shift your weight onto your left leg.
Curl your right leg by bending your knee, bringing your heel towards your glutes while keeping your upper leg stationary.
Slowly return to the starting position, straightening your leg and controlling the resistance band.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
tips: Focus on squeezing your hamstrings at the top of the movement to enhance muscle activation.
Maintain an upright posture throughout the exercise; avoid leaning forward or backward.
Keep your supporting knee slightly bent to maintain balance.
results.description: Band Standing Leg Curl is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Calves.

results.name: Band Two Legs Calf Raise - (Band Under Both Legs) Version 2
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart on the resistance band, holding the ends in each hand with the band securely anchored under both feet.
Rise up onto your forefeet, lifting your heels as high as possible while keeping the tension in the band.
Slowly lower your heels back to the floor, maintaining control throughout the movement.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily, exhaling as you rise up and inhaling as you lower down.
Keep your knees slightly bent to avoid locking them out during the movement.
Focus on squeezing your calves at the top of the movement to enhance muscle activation.
results.description: Band Two Legs Calf Raise - (Band Under Both Legs) Version 2 is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shins.

results.name: Banded Feet Elevated Hip Thrusters
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides and your heels placed on an elevated surface such as a bench or box. Wrap a resistance band just above your knees to add extra glute activation.
Bend your knees at approximately 90 degrees and keep your feet hip-width apart. Brace your core and maintain a neutral spine.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips off the ground by contracting your glutes, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your knees at the top.
Pause at the top while pushing your knees slightly outward against the band, then lower your hips back to the ground in a controlled motion. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure the resistance band stays under consistent tension throughout the movement.
Drive through your heels to maximize glute activation.
Do not let your legs cave inward; push them outward against the band.
Exhale as you lift your hips, and inhale as you lower your hips.
results.description: Banded Feet Elevated Hip Thrusters is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Quadriceps, Abductors.

results.name: Barbell Bench Lateral Step-Up
instructions: Stand beside a bench with a barbell across your upper back. Your hands should grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step laterally onto the bench with your closest foot, pushing through your heel to lift your body up onto the bench.
Bring your trailing leg up to meet the stepping leg by the bench, maintaining balance and control.
Step down off the bench with your trailing leg first, then the stepping leg. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
tips: Ensure your entire foot is placed on the bench to provide a stable base for the step-up.
Move slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you step up and inhaling as you step down.
results.description: Barbell Bench Lateral Step-Up is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Barbell Bench Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, back facing a bench, holding a barbell across your upper back. Your hands should grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your chest up. Begin the squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees, lowering your body until you sit down on the bench.
Push through your heels to stand back up to the starting position, extending your hips and knees fully. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your knees track over your toes to prevent knee injuries and ensure proper form.
Keep your chest up and back straight throughout the movement to maintain proper alignment.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you push up and inhaling as you lower down.
results.description: Barbell Bench Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Lower Back.

results.name: Barbell Box Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, back facing a sturdy box. Position a barbell across your upper back, gripping it with both hands, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Slowly lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, keeping your back straight.
Lower yourself until your glutes lightly touch the box or bench. Ensure your knees track over your toes and do not cave inward.
Push through your heels to stand back up to the starting position, extending your hips and knees fully. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your knees track over your toes to prevent knee injuries and ensure proper form.
Lower your body slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you push up and inhaling as you lower down.
results.description: Barbell Box Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Lower Back.

results.name: Barbell Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Stand with your back turned to a bench, holding a barbell across your upper back. Grip the bar with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Place one foot behind you on the bench, ensuring the top of your foot is resting on the bench.
Keep your chest up, and maintain a neutral spine. Begin the squat by bending your front knee and lowering your body until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push through the heel of your front foot to return to the starting position, extending your hip and knee fully. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
tips: Ensure your front knee tracks over your toes to prevent knee injuries and ensure proper form.
Lower your body slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you push up and inhaling as you lower down.
results.description: Barbell Bulgarian Split Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Lower Back.

results.name: Barbell Calf Jump
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and a barbell placed securely across your upper back. Keep your torso upright.
Bend your knees to preload tension, keeping your heels grounded.
Extend your knees and drive through your forefeet to raise your heels explosively, lifting your body upward without jumping off the ground.
Slowly lower your heels back to the floor and repeat.
tips: Focus on pushing through your forefeet to maximize calf activation.
Control the descent to avoid bouncing or slamming your heels.
Keep your knees soft and slightly bent throughout the movement.
results.description: Barbell Calf Jump is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the plyometric category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Hamstrings, Glutes.

results.name: Barbell Clean Grip Front Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with a clean grip (palms facing up, elbows pointing forward). The barbell should rest on the front of your shoulders, and your fingers should be under the bar to support it.
Begin the squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees, lowering your body until your thighs are parallel to the floor or slightly below.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position, extending your hips and knees fully. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your elbows stay high throughout the movement to keep the barbell in place.
Lower your body slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you push up and inhaling as you lower down.
results.description: Barbell Clean Grip Front Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Lower Back.
